data.long_description:
Experience beachfront luxury in this exquisite 3-bedroom residence at Kempinski Palm Residences, located on the iconic Palm Jumeirah. Spanning an impressive 3,754.99 sq. ft., this beautifully designed home offers expansive living spaces, elegant interiors, and a resort-inspired lifestyle with direct access to a private beach.

Designed for those who appreciate space and sophistication, the residence features generously sized en-suite bedrooms, a bright open-plan living and dining area, and high-quality finishes throughout. Residents enjoy the renowned five-star hospitality and premium amenities associated with the Kempinski brand, making this an exceptional home for families and discerning investors.

Property Features:

• 3 Bedrooms
• 4 Bathrooms
• Size: 3,754.99 Sq. Ft.
• Spacious Living & Dining Area
• Modern Fully Fitted Kitchen
• En-suite Bedrooms with Built-in Wardrobes
• Guest Powder Room
• Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
• Large Balcony/Terrace
• Premium Finishes Throughout
• Covered Parking

Community Amenities:

• Private Beach Access
• Resort-Style Swimming Pools
• State-of-the-Art Fitness Centre
• Luxury Spa & Wellness Facilities
• Landscaped Gardens
• Children's Play Area
• Concierge & Valet Services
• Fine Dining Restaurants & Cafés
• 24/7 Security

Located on the world-famous Palm Jumeirah, Kempinski Palm Residences offers effortless access to premium shopping, fine dining, entertainment destinations, and Dubai's major business districts, delivering an unmatched waterfront lifestyle in one of the city's most prestigious addresses.
